sourceAssessment.result: The lexical local initializes False immediately before the existing protected attempt. Its only other assignment is True immediately after the same direct run_traced call returns. It is not a caller argument, serialized report, closure setter or authority flag. Trusted same-process mutation remains outside this guarantee.

Any exception escaping run_traced leaves the marker false, including startup/callback failures, OwnedCleanupError, stream-close/subreaper restoration errors and interrupts. An interrupt before the True assignment also conservatively refuses even if cleanup may have succeeded. No exception path promotes the marker.

The existing original-worker bounded join and inactivity condition still precede the new gate. The false branch invokes an always-raising helper before eight-slot/provenance transfer, slot clearing, cleanup, diagnostic retention and report publication. run.closed remains False. Normal output-writer disposal remains after captured first-error rethrow.

Helper calls unchanged raise_first: exact captured body exception wins, then first cleanup exception, otherwise fixed generic refusal. No error string/repr/truth conversion or public raw-error projection is added. Inner run_traced finalizers may still mask earlier failures; this change preserves only the exception actually delivered to supervisor.

Normal return requires existing synchronous call finalizers to finish without escaping an error; this is not independent validation of their implementation. A nonzero child result or later replay/report failure can follow normal return. The extra condition permits only the existing disposal path after other required conditions; it grants no launch or connected authority.

Skipping explicit finalizer cleanup does not retain a durable recovery graph. Raw integer slots do not auto-close but bookkeeping can be lost; query/diagnostic owners have no inspected destructor hooks, own_tracer stores identity rather than Popen ownership, and ObservedRun omits the complete live resource graph. Tracebacks and Popen destructor bookkeeping do not provide surviving custody. Early acquisitions/startup before the protected attempt remain outside scope.
